BL-1335 — Token-exhaustion evidence is never promoted into a failover record, so the wired outage-failover consumer only ever acts on records a human typed by hand
What it solves: ## Findings recorded at mint, each verified rather than assumed
Approval context: One fork, and it is the autonomy bar. Opening a failover record is not inert - BL-669's consumer reads it and will restaff the seat. So the question is how confident the classifier must be before it opens one on its own.
Two facts that should inform it. Opening a record does NOT cause a mid-turn sw…
BL-1335 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1335" (or "reject BL-1335 <reason>") to act.
